subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with details in mutating, heartbeat, cron, and full-verbose contexts be hidden by default, or should those detail paths remain visible unless the agent acknowledged the failure?
rationale: Current tests preserve visible warning details for several exec paths, while this PR assumes all exec-like warning details are noise; automation should not choose that product contract.

options.title: Adopt a Narrow Suppression Policy
options.body: Suppress benign or non-mutating exec-like warning noise, but keep mutating and detail-critical failure warnings visible unless the agent explicitly acknowledges them.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update tests to intentionally hide all exec/bash warning details by default.

options.title: Preserve Current Warning Semantics
options.body: Reject this branch and narrow the linked issue to a separately proven warning leak rather than changing the existing detail-mode behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt a Narrow Suppression Policy
recommendation.body: Suppress benign or non-mutating exec-like warning noise, but keep mutating and detail-critical failure warnings visible unless the agent explicitly acknowledges them.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the shared agent warning and mutation surfaces touched by the decision.
